name: muslim-mods
description: Prayer times, the Hijri date, adhkar, a daily ayah, sunnah fasting, Ramadan, Jumu'ah and tasbih in Claude Code, each switched on or off from one dashboard: /muslim.

prayerTimes.title: Prayer times
prayerTimes.description: The countdown to the next prayer, a reminder before it and a toast when it begins. Hijri date, adhkar, fasting, Ramadan and Jumu'ah read their times from it.

hijriDate.title: Hijri date
hijriDate.description: The Hijri date under the prompt and a toast on the days that matter. Sunnah fasting and Ramadan read their dates from it.

adhkar.title: Adhkar
adhkar.description: The morning and evening adhkar: a reminder, and /adhkar to read them.

dailyAyah.title: Daily ayah
dailyAyah.description: A verse of the Qur'an above the prompt, a new one each session.

sunnahFasting.title: Sunnah fasting
sunnahFasting.description: A reminder the evening before a sunnah fast, then suhur and iftar on the days you fast.

ramadan.title: Ramadan
ramadan.description: In Ramadan, the countdown to imsak and iftar, suhur, iftar and Tarawih reminders.

jumuah.title: Jumu'ah
jumuah.description: Salawat and Al-Kahf from Thursday's Maghrib, the Friday prayer and the last hour after Asr.

tasbih.title: Tasbih
tasbih.description: When the 5-hour or weekly limit runs out, an invitation to dhikr with a counter.

city.title: City
city.description: Your city ("Istanbul") or coordinates ("41.01, 28.98"). Leave blank to detect it from your IP.

method.title: Calculation method
method.description: The Fajr and Isha angles. Auto picks the one used in your country.

ihtiyatMinutes.title: Ihtiyat (minutes)
ihtiyatMinutes.description: Safety margin added to each prayer time; -1 uses the method's own (2 for Kemenag and JAKIM, 0 elsewhere).

reminderMinutes.title: Reminder (minutes before)
reminderMinutes.description: How early to remind you; 0 turns the early reminder off.

sunnahReminders.title: Dhuha and Tahajud reminders
sunnahReminders.description: A toast when the time for Dhuha, and for Tahajud (the last third of the night), begins, and a note under the prompt while it lasts.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Umm al-Qura (Saudi Arabia's, the default) or the arithmetical tabular calendar.

adjustDays.title: Adjust (days)
adjustDays.description: Where the month begins by local moon sighting (Indonesia, Malaysia, Pakistan…), set -1 or 1 to match your country's announcement.

announceDays.title: Announce special days
announceDays.description: A toast for Ramadan, the Eids, Arafah, Ashura and the other days that matter.

reminderDelayMinutes.title: Reminder delay (minutes)
reminderDelayMinutes.description: How long after Fajr and Asr begin to remind you, leaving time to pray first.

showArabic.title: Show Arabic
showArabic.description: Show the Arabic text in the adhkar and tasbih panes and the daily ayah. Off by default: many terminals draw Arabic as unjoined letters, left to right.

mondayThursday.title: Monday and Thursday
mondayThursday.description: Remind you the evening before every Monday and Thursday.

whiteDays.title: White days
whiteDays.description: Remind you the evening before the 13th, 14th and 15th of each Hijri month (Ayyam al-Bid).

suhurMinutes.title: Suhur reminder (minutes before Fajr)
suhurMinutes.description: On a day you fast (Ramadan, or a sunnah fast you said you'd keep), how long before Fajr to remind you of suhur; 0 turns it off.

imsakMinutes.title: Imsak (minutes before Fajr)
imsakMinutes.description: When imsak is, before Fajr (10 in Indonesia and Malaysia); 0 turns the imsak reminder off.

tarawih.title: Tarawih reminder
tarawih.description: A toast at Isha on each night of Ramadan.

jumuahReminderMinutes.title: Friday prayer reminder (minutes before Dhuhr)
jumuahReminderMinutes.description: For those who attend the Friday prayer: how early to remind you to get ready; 0 turns it off.

kahf.title: Al-Kahf on the hint line
kahf.description: Show Al-Kahf under the prompt from Thursday's Maghrib until you've read it (/jumuah read) or Friday's Maghrib.
